summary: Wrap Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose a private placement purchase of Series A Preferred Shares of Frenel Imaging Ltd. for $2 million ($26.6959/share). The transaction is an investment by the registrant, not a special situation. No terms like premium, board recommendation, or advisor are provided. The deal includes optional additional investments up to $2.5 million. Watch for future closings but no risk-arb angle.
